review_method: Independent inline Python review; did not import or execute aggregation script. Recalculated argmax/class recalls/BA/accuracy from all original NPZ logits and CE using max-shift log-sum-exp with Python math.fsum; independently regrouped all3 seeds within six participant IDs.
independent_unit: six published development participant identities; seeds are repeated fits
limitations: Source validation selected checkpoint epoch; reported scores are descriptive development measurements, not an independent held-out generalization estimate.
No confidence interval or departure-from-chance significance test is warranted by this descriptive validation summary.
CE is the mean of recorded frozen Torch CE values; independent NumPy/Python recalculation differs only within the unchanged 1e-7 audit tolerance.
No matched CPU target-query comparison, task-aware policy benefit, neural learning, retention or clinical conclusion follows.

Generic formal_train currently refits all18x3 and then opens query; it must not be invoked as the next stage for accepted18. Saved-checkpoint-only evaluation requires a separate frozen reviewed entry.
Future same-cohort adaptation remains exploratory after earlier final-baseline exposure; task/power/CSP measurement reliability does not itself validate an adaptation gate.
